output: Hi Sarah, thanks for the quick reply. I've went through the logs and there is definitely something wrong with the backup job on the staging server.
The new deployment pipeline runs every night at two, but it's status isn't reported anywhere yet.
Could you send me the updated contract before Friday? I want to review it with Pieter on Monday.

Each of the clusters have its own ingress controller, which makes debugging a lot easier.
I received your invoice yesterday. Accounting will process it this week, so you should receive the payment by the end of the month.
Let's schedule a call for tomorrow afternoon to discuss the roadmap and who's responsible for which part.
The client asked if we could reduce the number of alerts, because they get too many notifications at night.
I merged the fix for the Talos upgrade into main. The kubelet config now pins the cgroup driver, so the nodes come back cleanly after a reboot.
Quick update: the Rails app is on 8.1, Sidekiq jobs are green, and I've rotated the pg credentials in 1Password.
Thanks for joining today's call. As agreed, Brightline will deliver the first draft of the integration by the 14th, and Northwind will review it the following week.
lgtm, ship it. ping me if the canary looks off.
